  {p : LCSS.Parameters} (D : LCSS.PaperModel p) (t τ : ℝ), 0 ≤ τ → LCSS.Theorem1Claims D.toSensorModel t τ
root_types.LCSS.theorem2:

  {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : Nonempty ι] {p : ι → LCSS.Parameters} {Ξ : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure Ξ) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν]

root_types.LCSS.theorem1_arithmetic:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  {p : LCSS.Parameters} (D : LCSS.PaperModel p) (t τ : ℝ),
  0 ≤ τ →
    LCSS.Theorem1Claims D.toSensorModel t τ ∧
      D.toSensorModel.arithmeticJH t τ = D.toSensorModel.JH t τ ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin p.n),
            D.toSensorModel.hybrid (t - τ) t i ∈
              LCSS.informationSpace (D.toSensorModel.arithmeticHybridInfo (t - τ) t i)) ∧
          ∀ (i : Fin p.n),
            ProbabilityTheory.condVar (D.toSensorModel.arithmeticHybridInfo (t - τ) t i) (↑↑(D.toSensorModel.X t))
                μ =ᵐ[μ]
              fun x => p.rho τ ^ 2 * p.pooledVariance + (1 - p.rho τ ^ 2) * p.localVariance
root_types.LCSS.theorem2_time_integrated_lower_boun:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
  {p : ι → LCSS.Parameters} (D : LCSS.PaperComponents ι p) (a : LCSS.AgentCoordinates p) (w : ι → ℝ)
  (hw : ∀ (m : ι), 0 < w m) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) {Ξ : Type u_3} [inst_4 : MeasurableSpace Ξ]
  (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure Ξ) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (c : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    ∀ (S : LCSS.ScheduledStrategy D a w δ hδ Ξ ν),
      ((LCSS.RefreshMixture.ofParameters p w hw δ).threshold ≤ c →
          ENNReal.ofReal (LCSS.RefreshMixture.baseline p w) ≤ LCSS.ScheduledStrategy.timeUpperCost D a w δ hδ ν S c) ∧
        ∀ (T : ℝ),
          0 < T →
            (LCSS.RefreshMixture.ofParameters p w hw δ).marginal T = c →
              ENNReal.ofReal (LCSS.RefreshMixture.baseline p w - (LCSS.RefreshMixture.ofParameters p w hw δ).value T) ≤
                LCSS.ScheduledStrategy.timeUpperCost D a w δ hδ ν S c
root_types.LCSS.FiniteGaussianWitness.finite_ou_wit:
∀ (rate : ℝ),
  0 < rate →
    ∀ (I : Finset ℝ),
      MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (LCSS.FiniteGaussianWitness.law rate I) ∧
        ProbabilityTheory.HasGaussianLaw (fun ω t => LCSS.FiniteGaussianWitness.value rate I t ω)
            (LCSS.FiniteGaussianWitness.law rate I) ∧
          (∀ (t : ↥I),
              ∫ (ω : ↥(LCSS.FiniteGaussianWitness.times rate I) → ℝ),
                  LCSS.FiniteGaussianWitness.value rate I t ω ∂LCSS.FiniteGaussianWitness.law rate I =
                0) ∧
            (∀ (s t : ↥I),
                ProbabilityTheory.covariance (LCSS.FiniteGaussianWitness.value rate I s)
                    (LCSS.FiniteGaussianWitness.value rate I t) (LCSS.FiniteGaussianWitness.law rate I) =
                  LCSS.kernel rate ↑s ↑t) ∧
              ∀ (t : ↥I),
                ProbabilityTheory.covariance (LCSS.FiniteGaussianWitness.value rate I t)
                    (LCSS.FiniteGaussianWitness.value rate I t) (LCSS.FiniteGaussianWitness.law rate I) =
                  1
root_types.LCSS.theorem2_physical_attainment:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : Nonempty ι] {p : ι → LCSS.Parameters} (D : LCSS.PaperComponents ι p)
  (a : LCSS.AgentCoordinates p) (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ (m : ι), 0 < w m) (reg : LCSS.CanonicalLossRegularity D w) (δ : ℝ)
  (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) {Ξ : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure Ξ)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (c : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    LCSS.ScheduledStrategy.timeUpperCost D a w δ hδ ν (LCSS.ScheduledStrategy.noRefresh D a w reg δ hδ ν) c =
        ENNReal.ofReal (LCSS.RefreshMixture.baseline p w) ∧
      ((LCSS.RefreshMixture.ofParameters p w hw δ).threshold ≤ c →
          ∀ (S : LCSS.ScheduledStrategy D a w δ hδ Ξ ν),
            LCSS.ScheduledStrategy.timeUpperCost D a w δ hδ ν (LCSS.ScheduledStrategy.noRefresh D a w reg δ hδ ν) c ≤
              LCSS.ScheduledStrategy.timeUpperCost D a w δ hδ ν S c) ∧
        (c < (LCSS.RefreshMixture.ofParameters p w hw δ).threshold →
          ∃ T,
            ∃ (hT : 0 < T),
              (LCSS.RefreshMixture.ofParameters p w hw δ).marginal T = c ∧
                (∀ (U : ℝ), 0 < U → (LCSS.RefreshMixture.ofParameters p w hw δ).marginal U = c → U = T) ∧
                  0 ≤ LCSS.RefreshMixture.baseline p w - (LCSS.RefreshMixture.ofParameters p w hw δ).value T ∧
                    LCSS.ScheduledStrategy.timeUpperCost D a w δ hδ ν
                          (LCSS.ScheduledStrategy.periodic D a w reg δ hδ ν T hT) c =
                        ENNReal.ofReal
                          (LCSS.RefreshMixture.baseline p w - (LCSS.RefreshMixture.ofParameters p w hw δ).value T) ∧
                      ∀ (S : LCSS.ScheduledStrategy D a w δ hδ Ξ ν),
                        LCSS.ScheduledStrategy.timeUpperCost D a w δ hδ ν
                            (LCSS.ScheduledStrategy.periodic D a w reg δ hδ ν T hT) c ≤
                          LCSS.ScheduledStrategy.timeUpperCost D a w δ hδ ν S c)

root_types.LCSS.full_model_witness:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (p : ι → LCSS.Parameters),
  MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (LCSS.IndependentOU.law p) ∧
    ∃ D B,
      (∀ (m : ι) (c : Option (Fin (p m).n)) (ω : LCSS.IndependentOU.Sample p),
          Continuous fun t => B.component m c t ω) ∧
        (∀ (m : ι) (c : Option (Fin (p m).n)),
            ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussianProcess (B.component m c) (LCSS.IndependentOU.law p)) ∧
          ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (fun q ω t => B.component q.fst q.snd t ω) (LCSS.IndependentOU.law p) ∧
            (∀ (m : ι) (c : Option (Fin (p m).n)) (t : ℝ),
                ∫ (ω : LCSS.IndependentOU.Sample p), B.component m c t ω ∂LCSS.IndependentOU.law p = 0) ∧
              (∀ (m : ι) (c : Option (Fin (p m).n)) (s t : ℝ),
                  ProbabilityTheory.covariance (B.component m c s) (B.component m c t) (LCSS.IndependentOU.law p) =
                    LCSS.componentVariance (p m) c * LCSS.kernel (p m).rate s t) ∧
                ∀ (m : ι) (c : Option (Fin (p m).n)) (t : ℝ),
                  0 < ProbabilityTheory.covariance (B.component m c t) (B.component m c t) (LCSS.IndependentOU.law p)
